title: Austin Water Works and Electric Light Rate Changes 1896
summary:
• **Major utility rate changes approved**: The city council passed an amended ordinance governing Austin's Water Works and Electric Light and Power Plants, though the vote was close (13-4) with some aldermen planning to challenge it.

• **New management structure established**: The mayor appointed a three-person Water and Light Committee (Aldermen Tobin, Lawless, and Fischer) and hired two temporary superintendents—Walter Johnson to oversee the power house and H.A. Stuckey to manage outside works.

• **Contentious vote with reconsideration attempts**: Four aldermen voted against the ordinance, and two others immediately gave notice they would move to reconsider it at the next meeting, indicating significant disagreement over the utility policy changes.

Minutes of a Called Meeting of the City Council.
Austin, Texas, Aug. 29th 1896.
Hon. Lewis Hancock, Mayor, presiding.
Roll, called.
Present, Aldermen Glass, Goch, Hopton, Lawless, Platt, Powell, Robertson, Rosengern,
Schneider, Shelley, Stumpf, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend and Zilker 15.
Absent, Aldermen Beaty, Fischer, Glascock, Haynes, Linn, Nitschke, and Redd. 7.
Call of Council     The following call of the Council was read:
Austin, Tex., Aug. 29, 1896.
We the undersigned members of the City Council of the City of Austin, hereby call a
special meeting of the Council to assemble in the City Hall this (Saturday) Evening,
August 29, at 5:30, for the purpose of considering an ordinance how pending, amending an
ordinance entitled "An ordinance providing for the management and operation of the Water
Works and Electric Light and Power Plants of the City of Austin, establishing rules and
regulations for the government thereof, and fixing rates for service."
G. B. Nitschke,
R. C. Robertson,
W. D. Shelley,
Wm. H. Tobin,
A. C. Goch,
Francis Fischer,
Thos. T. Taylor,
Joseph Stumpf.

Marshals certificate     Austin, Tex., Aug. 29, 1896, 4. P.M.
I hereby certify, that the following named Aldermen have been served with the above call
by having it read to each of them in person, viz: Beaty, Fischer, Glass, Goch, Haynes,
Hopton, Lawless, Nitschke, Platt, Powell, Redd, Robertson, Rosengern, Schneider, Shelley,
Stumpf, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend and Zilker, and that Alderman Linn has been served by a
true copy, having been left at his place of residence, he being out of the city; also that
a true copy has been left at Alderman Glascock's last known place of residence in the
City.
James E. Lucy, City Marshal.
Per. McClushing

Ord. amending certain Aldermen Fischer and Nitschke entered the Council Chamber. sections
of W.W. Ord. The Mayor then laid before the Council an ordinance amending certain sections
of an ordinance entitled "An ordinance providing for the management and operation of the
Water Works, Electric Light and Power Plants of the City of Austin, and establishing rules
and regulations for the government thereof and fixing rates for service."


 --- Page break --- 

461.

Ord. read 3rd time &
final passage

The ordinance was read a third time and passed by the following vote: Yeas Aldermen
Fischer, Glass, Gorth, Lawless, Stitschne, Platt, Roberdeau, Schneider, Shelley, Skumbt,
Taylor, Tobin and Zilker 13.
Stays Aldeymen Horton, Powell, Rosengren and Townsend 4.
Aldermen Glass and Schneider gave notice that at the next meeting of the Council they
would move to reconsider the vote by which this ordinance was passed.
Alderman Stitschne moved to reconsider the vote by which the ordinance was passed.
Alderman Taylor moved to table the motion. Carried, by the following vote: Yeas, Aldermen
Fischer, Glass, Gorth, Lawless, Stitschne, Roberdean, Shelley, Skumbt, Taylor, Tobin and
Zilker. 11.
Stays, Aldermen Horton, Platt, Powell, Rosengren, Schneider and Townsend 6.

Aldermen Tobin Lawless
Fischer appointed W.&L.
Committee.
Walter Johnson appointed in
Charge of Power House and
H. A. Stuckey in charge of
Outside works to be Tempo-
rary Superintendents, and
Confirmed by Council

The Mayor announced the appointment of Aldermen Tobin, Lawless and Fischer as the Water
and Light Committee provided for in the ordinance.
The Mayor nominated, Walter Johnson in charge of the Power house and H. A. Stuckey in
charge of the Outside works to be Temporary Superintendents and asked their confirmation
Alderman Taylor moved that the nominations made by the Mayor be confirmed, which motion
prevailed by the following vote: Yeas Aldermen Fischer, Gorth, Horton, Lawless, Stitschne,
Platt, Powell, Roberdeau, Rosengren, Schneider, Shelley, Skumbt, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend
and Zilker 16.
Stays Alderman Glass 1.
On motion the Council adjourned.

Jno. A. Johnson
City Clerk.
